categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Haixin Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: bioenergy (including hydrotreated vegetable oil (HVO) biodiesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF)), catalytic purification materials (such as desulfurization catalysts and other specialized catalysts), and specialty chemicals (including products like new pentanediol, LNG, styrene, and synthetic ammonia). The company also provides integrated energy industry services and technical consulting.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary suspended bed hydrogenation technology and improved fixed-bed hydrogenation processes for producing hydrocarbon biofuels from waste oils. It has developed mature technologies for biofuel production, including HEFA-SPK process for SAF. In catalytic materials, it focuses on iron-based purification materials, ruthenium-based catalysts, and advanced catalyst manufacturing. The company also employs advanced MCT suspended bed hydrogenation technology for processing heavy oils and has patented numerous technologies related to catalysts and biofuel production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large international energy suppliers and bulk commodity traders, primarily in Europe, Japan, South Korea, and other Asian markets. The bioenergy products serve transportation sectors, especially in regions with renewable energy mandates. Catalytic materials are sold mainly to petroleum refining, coal chemical, and natural gas chemical industries, with major clients being state-owned oil companies like PetroChina and Sinopec. Specialty chemicals serve automotive, textile, pharmaceutical, and industrial fuel markets domestically.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Beijing, Shandong, Hainan, Inner Mongolia, and other provinces. It has overseas subsidiaries and sales platforms in the United States, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and markets in Europe, Japan, South Korea, Australia, and Canada. Export sales constitute a significant portion of revenue, especially for biofuels.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Haixin Energy Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the bioenergy and chemical supply chains. It procures raw materials such as waste oils and methanol, processes them into biofuels and specialty chemicals, and sells finished products to energy suppliers and industrial customers. It also provides catalytic materials and technical services to refining and chemical production facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in biofuel production technologies, including expanding SAF capacity and optimizing hydrogenation catalysts. It invests in R&D for improving raw material utilization, production efficiency, and product quality. Strategic priorities include expanding non-EU markets, developing customized biofuel products, advancing catalytic purification technologies, and supporting industry standards. The company also focuses on cost control, supply chain diversification, and enhancing resilience against market fluctuations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of biofuels, catalytic materials, and specialty chemicals. The company employs a direct sales model with long-term contracts and spot sales, including general trade and toll processing arrangements. It also earns income from integrated energy services, technical consulting, and equipment leasing. Export sales and domestic pilot projects contribute to revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in hydrocarbon biofuels and catalytic purification materials, holding a strong position with advanced proprietary technologies and certifications. It competes with other biofuel producers and catalyst manufacturers, including large state-owned enterprises. Its membership in major industry networks and status as a primary supplier to PetroChina and Sinopec enhance its competitive positioning. The company faces challenges from EU anti-dumping measures but is expanding into new markets to mitigate risks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported a significant revenue decline of 68.3% to approximately RMB 2.43 billion, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 954 million, mainly due to EU anti-dumping duties and lower biofuel prices. Total assets were about RMB 9.7 billion, with equity of RMB 6.38 billion. The company is undergoing restructuring and capacity expansion, including a 200,000-ton biofuel project expected to start production in 2025. Despite short-term losses, it maintains substantial R&D investment and strategic growth plans.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-quality hydrocarbon biofuels with superior carbon reduction benefits, meeting stringent domestic and international standards, including aviation fuel certifications. Its proprietary suspended bed hydrogenation technology allows flexible raw material use and efficient production. In catalytic materials, it provides advanced, long-life, and regenerable products tailored for refining and chemical industries. The company emphasizes cost competitiveness, product customization, and integrated technical services to deliver environmental and economic value to customers.
